In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MOF 5 is a good candidate for gas separation applications, and it can be used as a filler for the manufacturing MMM.
the MMMs manufactured by introducing MOF 5 within PI showed higher gas permeability and selectivity than MMMs which were prepared by using MOFs including triple metal ions.
the gas permeation rate of the MMMs was increased with the incorporation of MOFs within PI, and the gas permeation was also increased with increasing transmembrane pressure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gas permeation through MMMs is affected not only by the gas adsorption capacity of MOFs, but also by the interaction of MOFs and PI.

the incorporation of MOF 0.5 in a polyimide matrix is a promising approach to enhance gas permeability of the membrane and the separation of H2 and CO2.
